_doc: R3 P1 §12 C1 — REVIEWED page timer bounds (contract/timer-bounds.js). pages: the asserted pages and the settle() horizon their steps use. wrappers: reviewed timer wrapper names per unit. sites: every timer whose delay exceeds the page horizon or is unresolved, with reachesAsserted (does its effect reach an output a step asserts?) and the reason; bound to the call text (sha256). chains: every timer CHAIN (callback arming another timer, name-resolved within the unit) whose cumulative delay exceeds the horizon, is unresolved or repeats — { cumulativeBoundMs, repeatLimit, reachesAsserted, reason } bound to its call texts. periodic: every interval firing within the horizon — { periodMs, mayChange, mayChangeSelectors (blanked by the §5b recapture), changesAsserted:false }. Every reviewed site / chain / periodic entry is also bound to ctrlSha: its CONTROLLING scope (outermost enclosing function incl. loops + the declarations its delay and loops reference).

exception.reason: the confirmation's order number (R15 NUM) is painted by form-order-number.js's poll (≤ 10 reads, 38.7 s) and hidden by its 45 s deadline — the product genuinely waits up to 45 s, so ONLY these timers, and ONLY the confirmation, get a 46 s horizon; the journey settles the confirmation steps (pay, confirmation, its stability recapture) with it and every other step with the standard 10 s
exception.authority: advisor 2026-10-13 (provisionally accepted, codex to confirm) — PLAN-R3-P1 §12 C1 reviewed exception

processPayment’s awaited steps: the address-pick cap (only while an address pick is in flight — not on S1’s GPS-OK path), then submitOrder’s token race (≤ 1500 ms) and retry backoff (≤ 1500 + 3000 ms, MAX_TRIES 3); the demo-branch and PixelPay steps are not on the cash path. On S1’s path the bound is 6000 ms, within the 10 s horizon — 6f353ed: submitOrder now also races the createOrder body for the tracking token (confirmTokenOf, ≤ 1500 ms, once on success) → bound 7500 ms ≤ the horizon
handlePaymentReturn’s status poll (5 s fetch timeout + 2.5 s waits until a deadline): the ONLINE payment return only (precondition not-online-payment) — never on S1

submitOrder's awaited steps on the real submit: the ID-token race (≤ 1500 ms), the retry backoff (1500, 3000 ms; MAX_TRIES 3) and — 6f353ed — the tracking-token race on the createOrder 200 body (confirmTokenOf, ≤ 1500 ms, once) before showSuccess; the 1500 ms demo sleep is the unconfigured-endpoint branch only. Bound 7500 ms ≤ the horizon; S1's first attempt succeeds

the confirmation's order-number poll (ORDER_NUMBER_DELAYS_MS: 700, 1500, 2500, 4000, then 5000 × 6 = 38.7 s, ≤ 10 reads, stopped once the number paints; the 45 s deadline hides the line).
